thread:
nina: Promo to staging for ai-ingress chart v2.6.0 blocked by canary preflight: values merge produced invalid ingress.hosts list. deploy-bot flagged schema error and auto-held. anyone have the merge diff?

deploy-bot: promote-blocked: preflight-values-schema, error=ingress.hosts: expected list[string], got string; merged values file: staging-overlay.yaml; action=hold; see /logs/deploybot/1766661234

carlos: I pulled the merged values from the deploy artifact. Looks like two teams edited staging overlay: one added a single host string, other expected a list. merge resulted in a plain string.

liz: that was my change to add test-host.redwood.ai as a quick verification. I didn't realize the helm chart expects a list. sorry, my bad.

harry: options: 1) quick hotpatch to the canary values to coerce string -> [string] and re-promote (fast), 2) pin staging back to v2.5.9 and abort (safe), 3) revert liz's change in overlay and re-run full promote after PR (takes ~30m).

nina: what's impact if we coerce in canary only? will chart behave differently in prod?

carlos: coercing only lets canary proceed but leaves overlay mismatch; if prod promotion happens later with overlay still wrong, we'll fail again. we should either pin now or hotpatch overlay upstream and schedule a prod freeze until fixed.

liz: I can open PR to fix overlay to use a list; ETA 10m. But that won't help this immediate promo. I'd prefer a short pin to avoid accidental prod push.

harry: agree pin to v2.5.9 for staging. then land PR and re-run promote once merged and a quick canary passes. release notes should call out temporary pin and the owner to validate ingress hosts.

nina: ok i'm aborting current promote and pinning staging to 2.5.9. @deploy-bot please record manual_pin.

deploy-bot: action=manual_pin, user=nina, reason="preflight-values-schema failed: ingress.hosts type mismatch after overlay merge", pinned_version=2.5.9, timestamp=1766661248

nina: audit steps i ran:
```
# inspect merged values
cat /deploybot/artifacts/1766661234/merged-values.yaml | yq .ingress.hosts
# abort promote
kubectl -n deploybot logs job/deploy-promote-1766661234 --tail=200
# rollback staging deployment to previous chart
kubectl -n staging rollout undo deployment/ai-ingress --to-revision=3
helm history ai-ingress -n staging
# annotate release for traceability
kubectl -n releases annotate release ai-ingress promoted-by=nina manual-pin-reason="values schema mismatch"
```

liz: opened PR to fix overlay -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/622 (converts ingress.hosts to list and adds a values schema unit test). Also added a small lint in CI to catch string/list mismatches for ingress.hosts.

carlos: added release-note fragment: "Staging promotion to v2.6.0 deferred and pinned to v2.5.9 due to values merge producing ingress.hosts type mismatch. PR#622 fixes overlay and CI lint added. Hotfix window scheduled Wed 13:00 UTC to re-run promotion after PR merge."

harry: filing in release tracker and notifying edge infra to watch DNS changes during the re-promo.

nina: thanks all. we'll unpin after PR merge and a green canary. :white_check_mark:
